verdict.rationale: Grafana's GitHub docs describe dynamic, reusable dashboards with template variables shown as dropdowns. Panel plugins provide many visualization types, and multiple data sources can be mixed in one graph. Dashboards can be defined in version-controlled files for GitOps and CI/CD, which makes them shareable across teams and environments. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of in-product sharing features (share links, snapshots, permissions), a detailed catalogue of visualization types, and stronger independent corroboration; community notes that the Node graph panel needs special metadata and that dashboard-building documentation is thin.
